item.text: Hi Alex, I realized that when we discussed your idea in today’s meeting, I didn’t acknowledge that it came from you. I’m sorry for the omission; you deserve clear recognition for your contribution. I’ll send a follow-up to everyone who attended, crediting you and highlighting how your suggestion shaped our discussion. I’ll also make sure the meeting notes reflect that and acknowledge your contribution at our next team meeting. Going forward, I’ll be more deliberate about giving credit when sharing others’ ideas.
